about: The greeter's, the visitor's and the rival's lines (named texts, docs/stages.md section 8). English is required; es-419 is this mod's own Spanish.

texts.welcome: Welcome to the park, friend! Take these 100 BIT, on the house.
texts.again: Good to see you again. Enjoy the park!
texts.thanks: Thanks for visiting! The gate to the east leads to another place.
texts.visitor: I am from another town. This park has a nice view.
texts.rival: Hey! Do I look like you? I march on the spot with a sprite of my own.
